recommendation: VERDICT: TERMINAL REJECT of topic t-01, 'Is Chapter 10, Magic System publishable as-is, and if not what is the tiered disposition plan?' The deterministic round-1 tally stands at refute 7, support 0, reject_quorum 4, impasse false, with all seven refutes (f-001..f-007) un-rebutted and ruled_topics empty. No judge was convened and no ruling was sealed, so rulings_applied is []. Chapter 10 is NOT publishable as written. CLEARED (verified clean by the members and not to be re-opened): the tier table's flat 2/4/8 DP costs, 1/2/3 Discipline counts and 2-4-6 / 6-9-12 / 9-15-21 effect rows against 08-disciplines.qmd:144-146 and 228-230; the Level 3 / Level 7 gates; Knowledge for arcane and Reason for divine against 03-attributes.qmd:98-100; the three outcome bands against 06-core-resolution.qmd:30; the worked roll recomputes to Strong (5+3+4=12, plus Knowledge +2, plus Arcana +1 = 15); both named spells exist under exactly those names, so neither is a phantom; the per-encounter cap against 20-bestiary.qmd:146; and the whole Typst layer (one {=typst} fence under the H1, outlined:false tables, named callout body, zero em/en-dashes, no bare @, heading levels unskipped, 8 page breaks yielding 9 consecutive pages with no blank page or stranded heading). BROKEN (the bounded repair set): one off-row damage value, one false blanket wildcard denial, one self-contradicting concentration rule, two incomplete tradition lists, a cantrip-pricing split across chapters, an unstated raise-cost, an unstated limitation precedence, a spell-table column width that wraps a card name mid-word in the built PDF, and zero outbound cross-references. Disposition is the tiered plan in 'resolved': four chapter-local mechanical fixes, six substantive cross-chapter corrections, and three design decisions resolved with recommended defaults.
rationale: Topic t-01 closed as a terminal reject by deterministic majority, not by a judgment call: the round-1 engine check returned refute 7, support 0, reject_quorum 4, impasse false, un_rebutted_refutes f-001..f-007, and ruled_topics [], so no judge was convened, no ruling was sealed, and rulings_applied is empty. The seven refutes converge rather than conflict. All seven independently flag the same two cross-chapter contradictions: [10-magic-system:65] denies any wildcard Discipline substitution while the shipped Odd signature Eccentric Spellcasting (05-classes.qmd:287, 02-character-creation.qmd:301, 21-glossary.qmd:81) exempts two chosen abilities and is played live at 13-combat.qmd:498; and [10-magic-system:133] gives an Adept Brimstone Burst a 15-point centre bonus that is off the Adept row 6/9/12 (08-disciplines.qmd:228-230) and absent from the canon card (11-arcane-spells.qmd:143, 19-gm-guidance.qmd:571). Six flag the [10-magic-system:29] versus [:115] concentration contradiction; five or six flag the incomplete arcane/divine enumerations at [:99] and [:101]; four flag the cantrip-pricing split (08-disciplines.qmd:214, 02-character-creation.qmd:145, 19-gm-guidance.qmd:604 versus 11-arcane-spells.qmd:27 and 12-divine-spells.qmd:27) and the unstated raise cost; two flag the [:74] '1 Fire, rank 3' notation against 08-disciplines.qmd:208; and the layout-expert independently reproduced the [:69] column overflow in the built PDF (page 161 renders 'Ember Lance (Master rank)' as 'Ember / Lance (Mas- / ter rank)'). Dissent was weighed as counter-signal, not opposition: every member also reports the numeric and taxonomic spine clean, and those checks are recorded as CLEARED and not re-opened. Where a member's severity label exceeded the evidence (the librarian called [:65] a blocking chapter-local Tier-1 fix) the finding was kept and the tier corrected, because the same false absolute sits at 08-disciplines.qmd:265 and the carve-out cites a shipped class signature. Where a member's fix exceeded canon (the researcher adding 'the Intellect' to the arcane list from ch05:507/526) the sub-claim was partially dismissed, since no arcane card keys to an Intellect Discipline. The three Tier-3 items are genuinely underdetermined by the current text, so each is resolved with a recommended default anchored on locked rulings (flat 2/4/8 DP card pricing; the one-roll 3d6 outcome mapping) and left veto-able by the lead designer.

resolved.outcome: TIER 1 MECHANICAL (chapter-local, no mechanics change) - [10-magic-system:133]: the worked example gives an Adept Brimstone Burst's Strong result a 15-point centre bonus, but the card was bought at Adept tier and its row is 6/9/12 (08-disciplines.qmd:228-230), 15 is a Master-row number, and the canon card prints no centre bonus (11-arcane-spells.qmd:143, 19-gm-guidance.qmd:571). Minimal fix: strike 'with targets near the center taking 15' (or restate it as '+1 damage tier') so every printed figure lands on the Adept row. Flagged by all seven.

TIER 1 MECHANICAL - [10-magic-system:69]: the spell table's columns (12.96%, 11.11%, 27.78%, 48.15%) give the Spell column about 0.61 in of usable width, so built PDF page 161 breaks 'Ember Lance (Master rank)' across three lines and hyphenates it mid-word. Minimal fix: rebalance to columns: (26%, 11%, 24%, 39%), keeping the align arity and trailing comma; sibling 08-disciplines.qmd:117 gives its equivalent lead column 34.15%. Verified against the built PDF by the layout-expert.

TIER 1 MECHANICAL - [10-magic-system:45] versus [:71]: the two table headers disagree on casing and wording ('Effect row' vs 'Effect Range', sentence case vs title case) and both abbreviate the three outcome words and Requirement to W / S / St with no key, while [:73] and [:133] disagree on unit style (20-ft vs 20-foot). Minimal fix: use one header wording, spell the outcome words out as 08-disciplines.qmd:227 does (or add a short key), and unify the radius unit. Flagged by the layout-expert and the author.

TIER 1 MECHANICAL - [10-magic-system:74]: the Master prerequisite prints as '1 Fire, rank 3' where the sibling rows print '1 Fire' and '2 Fire', and canon renders a Fire-only Master requirement as '3 Fire' (08-disciplines.qmd:208). Minimal fix: print '3 Fire', matching the tier-equals-rank-count convention. Flagged by the researcher and the game-architect.

TIER 2 SUBSTANTIVE / CROSS-CHAPTER - [10-magic-system:65]: the blanket claim 'There are no wildcard Discipline substitutions' is false; the Odd's shipped Eccentric Spellcasting exempts exactly two chosen abilities, one arcane and one divine, from Discipline prerequisites while level gates still bind (05-classes.qmd:287, 02-character-creation.qmd:301, 21-glossary.qmd:81) and 13-combat.qmd:498 plays it live. Minimal fix: one sentence naming Eccentric Spellcasting as the sole carve-out (not deleting the rule). The identical false absolute at 08-disciplines.qmd:265 is routed out of this chapter's micro-PR and fixed in the same pass. Flagged by all seven.

TIER 2 SUBSTANTIVE / CROSS-CHAPTER - [10-magic-system:29] versus [:115]: line 29 promises 'no concentration roll' while line 115 mandates a Fortitude check to maintain a concentration spell after damage; the later check is legitimate and does not replace the casting outcome mapping, so the absolute at 29 is the defect. Minimal fix: scope line 29 to the casting roll (no separate casting check, no spell-failure percentage) and keep the single maintenance rule in Limitations. While there, complete the [:115] procedure per the editor-in-chief: state the target (Standard or better on 3d6 + Fortitude), the success tier and the repeat-on-each-damaging-hit rule; the glossary already canonises the save at 21-glossary.qmd:127. Flagged by six.

TIER 2 SUBSTANTIVE / CROSS-CHAPTER - [10-magic-system:99] and [:101]: the arcane list names Fire, Wind, Water, Earth and Energy but omits Mind, which keys arcane cards at 11-arcane-spells.qmd:391 and a class ability at 05-classes.qmd:538; the divine list omits Plants, which keys 12-divine-spells.qmd:330; and Plants also keys an arcane card at 11-arcane-spells.qmd:280. Minimal fix: add Mind and Plants to the arcane list and Plants to the divine one, or explicitly mark both lists non-exhaustive. (The researcher's further request to name 'the Intellect' is not adopted: it is a class ability pool, not an arcane Discipline key.) Flagged by five or six.

TIER 2 SUBSTANTIVE / CROSS-CHAPTER - cantrip pricing: [10-magic-system:89], 11-arcane-spells.qmd:27 and 12-divine-spells.qmd:27 make cantrips free and automatic, while 08-disciplines.qmd:214, 02-character-creation.qmd:145 and 19-gm-guidance.qmd:604 price every no-prereq Novice basic, cantrips included, at 2 DP, so a starting Arcanist would receive ten cantrips the book prices at 20 DP. Minimal fix: reconcile all six sites to one rule; the recommended default (Tier-3 item b) keeps cantrips free and automatic, so the correction lands in the pricing chapters (08-disciplines.qmd:214, 02-character-creation.qmd:145, 19-gm-guidance.qmd:604) rather than here. Flagged by four.

TIER 2 SUBSTANTIVE / CROSS-CHAPTER - [10-magic-system:89] and the prerequisites section: the chapter carries zero outbound cross-reference tokens and sends readers to 'its spell chapter' in prose, so the framework never routes a reader to the chapters it summarises. Minimal fix: add @sec-chapter-arcane-spells and @sec-chapter-divine-spells at [:89] and @sec-chapter-disciplines (or the damage-budget table label) at the tier table and the prerequisites section, naming ch11 and ch12 explicitly. Flagged by the editor-in-chief, the layout-expert, the author and the librarian.

TIER 2 SUBSTANTIVE / CROSS-CHAPTER - de-duplication at [10-magic-system:13-15] and the callout at [:118-120]: the opener reprints sentences already at 01-introduction.qmd:215 and 05-classes.qmd:184 (the 'never useless / never out of options' pair, the spotlight rationale, the 'three times before lunch' punchline), making this the third printing of the same set piece. Minimal fix: cut the opener to one original sentence and cross-reference ch01; retarget the callout's rationale to the per-session rule it actually explains. Also qualify [:37] 'Every spell is a single growing card', which overreaches because cantrips have no tiers. Flagged by the author (adopted with the editorial sub-fixes).

TIER 3 DESIGN-DECISION (implement the recommended default, log as veto-able) - raise-cost at [10-magic-system:55]: the chapter says the tier sets both cost and effect row and that a card grows, but never states what raising an already-bought card costs, so a reader cannot tell whether lifting a Novice (2 DP) card to Master costs the full 8 DP or only the difference. RECOMMENDED DEFAULT: raising a card costs the DIFFERENCE toward the target tier's flat price, so the total paid equals the target tier price (2 DP more from Novice to Adept, 4 DP more from Novice to Master, 6 DP more from Adept to Master), and any newly required Discipline ranks are bought separately at their own cost. Rationale: the locked economy prices a card flat 2/4/8 DP by tier (08-disciplines.qmd:144-146), so a difference payment lands the total exactly on the tier price and keeps 'the row is the law' coherent. Flagged by the contrarian, the editor-in-chief, the game-architect and the librarian.

TIER 3 DESIGN-DECISION (implement the recommended default, log as veto-able) - cantrip roll resolution at [10-magic-system:89]: the chapter says no roll is required unless a cantrip says otherwise, yet every printed cantrip carries Weak / Standard / Strong lines (11-arcane-spells.qmd:49 and following), which lets a player always claim the Strong line. RECOMMENDED DEFAULT: cantrips stay free and automatic to learn and use for every caster of a tradition, and when an outcome actually matters they resolve on the same single 3d6 casting roll the rest of the book uses (attribute plus skill, mapped to Weak / Standard / Strong per 06-core-resolution.qmd:30), which closes the always-claim-Strong exploit without adding a second check. Rationale: this honours the locked one-roll principle while preserving the free-and-automatic cantrip grant. Flagged by the contrarian, the editor-in-chief, the game-architect and the researcher.

TIER 3 DESIGN-DECISION (implement the recommended default, log as veto-able) - limitation precedence at [10-magic-system:111] versus [:113]: [:111] caps Adept and Master spells at once per combat while [:113] caps Master spells at once per session, and no line states which governs when both bite, so the tighter reading is unclear. RECOMMENDED DEFAULT: the per-session Master cap is the tighter limit and governs when both apply, so a Master spell is at most once per session even across multiple fights, while Adept spells remain once per encounter. Rationale: the callout's own rationale at [:118-120] describes the Master cap as spotlight management 'once', and the Archmage block corroborates the once-per-fight cap at 20-bestiary.qmd:146. Flagged by the contrarian and the editor-in-chief.

dissent.position: Adopted fully on substance, re-tiered on severity: its defect set (65, 133, 99/101, 29) and its verified-clean spine are carried into the plan, but its label of 65 as a blocking chapter-local Tier-1 fix is corrected to Tier 2, because the same false absolute sits at 08-disciplines.qmd:265 and the carve-out cites a shipped class signature. Its clean checks (costs, gates, prereq shapes, casting attributes, Arcana skill, per-encounter cap, phantom-card check, worked roll) are recorded as CLEARED and not re-opened.

Adopted fully: all seven counter-examples survive recomputation. Its item 6 (unpriced raise) becomes Tier-3 default (a) on the difference-toward-target-price rule, and its item 7 (unresolved precedence) becomes Tier-3 default (c) that the per-session Master cap governs; its routing of the cantrip price clash to ch08 is the Tier-2 reconciliation. Its budget overgrant arithmetic on 133 is carried as the Tier-1 mechanical fix.

Adopted with correction: its 65, 29, 133, 99/101 and 74 findings stand. One sub-claim is partially dismissed - its request to add 'the Intellect' to the arcane list (cited from ch05:507/526) is not carried, because those citations are class ability pools and no arcane card keys to an 'Intellect' Discipline; the list edit is therefore limited to the canon-determined Discipline keys Mind and Plants.

Adopted fully: its budget recomputation (133 off-row, 15 being the Master Strong number), the 65 wildcard contradiction, the 29/115 clash, the 99/101 list gaps, the 74 notation and the missing raise delta all carry. Its P1/P2 ordering maps onto Tiers 1-2, its routed cantrip price clash onto the Tier-2 reconciliation, and its once-per-fight corroboration (20-bestiary.qmd:146) supports the Tier-3 precedence default.

Adopted: its de-duplication finding (13-15 and the 118-120 callout reprinting 01-introduction.qmd:215, 05-classes.qmd:184 and 01-introduction.qmd:212) becomes the Tier-2 de-dup item, and its header-naming finding and the 37 'single growing card' overreach (cantrips have no tiers) are folded into the Tier-1 header fix and the Tier-2 editorial fix. Its remaining repeat-statement and sentence-initial style notes are recorded as optional polish, not blocking, and are not part of the required repair set.

Adopted fully: its two contradictions (65, 29), the missing raise cost, the zero-cross-reference finding at 89, the unstated limitation precedence, and the incomplete concentration procedure (no target number, success tier or repeat rule) are all carried; the concentration-procedure completion is folded into the Tier-2 concentration fix and the precedence into Tier-3 default (c). Its structure and Typst clean checks are recorded as CLEARED.

Adopted fully: its Tier-1 column rebalance at 69 to (26%, 11%, 24%, 39%) is implemented as the Tier-1 mechanical fix; its header casing/wording and W / S / St key finding at 45/71 joins that Tier-1 entry (with its 20-foot vs 20-ft unit nit folded in), and its zero-outbound-cross-reference finding at 89 joins the Tier-2 cross-reference fix. Its verified-clean render checks (page breaks, no orphan page or stranded heading, em-dash law, table row completeness) are recorded as CLEARED and not re-opened.
